review.notes: Full review. Sample: all 15 seeded targets (1.1, 1.2, 2.3, 3.2, 3.3, 4.5, 4.8, 4.9, 5.1, 5.3, 5.4, 6.3, 7.3, 7.6, 7.8) read against the cached texts of CDN-CURVES, CDN-STEIN, CDN20, CDN23, CDN-DUKE, GK05, GK14, STR08, DAT06, THO24 (96 locators); the README flags no locator as unverified. Gate: every check passed; depcheck 0 problems, no UPWARD or CYCLE line. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probes on the headline fail (no padding); 21 pinned declarations opened; citations of 31 supplier roadmaps resolved. R01 (P1): the exact sequence of section 3.3 (CDN-CURVES Proposition 6.29) fails on the right for proper curves and is only p^2-exact, and A_st is undefined. R02-R04 (P3): undefined index set in 3.2(d), direction of the gluing isomorphism in 2.2 against 2.3, the undefined word 'recovered' in 0.1. Not a finding: README line 139 states a gap completed-semistable-ring-general-K (PadicHodgeTheory 0.6) that the declared-gaps list of the design lacks. Eight source issues recorded.
